en.value: 280 students travel either by train or bus or both to get to school. 140 students travel by train and 50 travel by both train and bus. Find the number of students who travel by just one these transport.

english.explanation: Let B and T denote the set of students travelling by bus and train respectively. Now, n(B ∪T) = n(B) + n(T) – n(B ∩T) gives, 280 = n(B) + 140 – 50 ⇒ n(B) = 190 Now, number of students travelling only by train = n(T) – n(B ∩T) = 140 – 50 = 90 Similarly, number of students travelling only by bus = 140 Therefore, number of students travelling by just one of these transports = 140 + 90 = 230
